node: Data-center power distribution, thermal management, liquid cooling, and electrical balance-of-system components
summary: Layer 1B expands the universe around AI data-center site-level bottlenecks. Vertiv remains the reference anchor for power/cooling infrastructure, but the underfollowed lane should prioritize smaller or messier-label public companies tied to thermal systems, electrical distribution, and qualified installation capacity. The strongest discovered candidates for later verification are Modine for Airedale data-center cooling, Powell Industries for medium-voltage switchgear and packaged power systems, and IES Holdings for data-center electrical/technology installation and infrastructure execution. These are research candidates only, not recommendations.
